chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام about the time of salat al-ẓuhr in the summer heat, but he did not answer me. Then later, he said to ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd ibn Hilāl: Zurārah asked me about the time of salat al-ẓuhr in the summer heat and I did not inform him, and I felt constrained because of that, so convey to him my greetings and tell him: when your shadow is equal to you, then perform salat al-ẓuhr; and when your shadow is twice your length, then perform salat al-ʿaṣr.

key_terms.ظِلُّكَ: your shadow, used here as the measure for prayer time
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time for performing an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When is the time of salat al-ẓuhr and salat al-ʿaṣr in the summer heat according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the time of salat al-ẓuhr and salat al-ʿaṣr during intense summer heat. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that salat al-ẓuhr is performed when a person's shadow equals his length, and salat al-ʿaṣr when the shadow becomes twice his length.
